summary: Fixed CWE-90 LDAP injection in the bad() entry point. User-controlled input from request.getParameter("name") was concatenated directly into the LDAP search filter "(cn=" + data + ")", allowing filter metacharacters to alter the query. Added an escapeLdapSearchFilter helper that escapes RFC 4515 special characters (\, *, (, ), NUL) and applied it to the input before building the filter. Legitimate values still search normally; the feature is preserved.
